content.title: Chapter 46 - HOUSING — Sec. 46-50. - Amount of rent.
content.summary:
The authority may rent or lease the dwelling accommodations therein only at rentals
               within the financial reach of such persons of low income.
(Code 1981, § 14-19; Ord. No. 1248, § 8(1)(b), 6-16-1975)
State Law reference—
Similar provisions, C.R.S. § 29-4-210(1)(b).
